categories.name: أَعْضَاءُ الْجَسَدِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Body parts mentioned in the Qur'an

items.verse: إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌۭ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
items.verseEn: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
items.verseEn: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."

items.verse: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
items.verseEn: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

items.verse: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
items.verseEn: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -

categories.name: أَلْفَاظٌ قُرْآنِيَّةٌ لِلْجَمَاعَاتِ
categories.nameEn: Quranic words for groups of people (folk, nation, chiefs, clan)

items.verse: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
items.verseEn: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

items.verse: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًۭا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
items.verseEn: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness [i.e., their prophet]. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].

items.verse: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِى سَفَاهَةٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
items.verseEn: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars."

items.verse: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌۭ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
items.verseEn: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."

categories.name: أَلْقَابٌ أَطْلَقَهَا الْمُكَذِّبُونَ عَلَى الْأَنْبِيَاءِ
categories.nameEn: Dismissive labels the disbelievers hurled at the prophets (sorcerer, madman, poet, one 'taught by others')

items.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
items.verseEn: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

items.verse: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
items.verseEn: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

items.verse: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
items.verseEn: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

items.verse: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
items.verseEn: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

categories.name: كَلِمَاتُ التَّعَجُّبِ وَالزَّجْرِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Standalone exclamations of rebuke in the Qur'an (fie!, far-fetched!, no indeed!, woe!)

items.verse: أُفٍّۢ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
items.verseEn: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
How far, how far, is that which you are promised.

items.verse: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
items.verseEn: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
